==About==

Sugar Caps can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Sugar Caps}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting Sugar Caps there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Sugar Caps can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.
